property.name: fieldSetName
property.label: Gift Aid Field Set Name
property.description: Please enter the exact developer API name of the Contact Field Set (e.g., GiftAidSectionFields)

property.name: showAddressInfo
property.label: Show Address Info
property.description: When checked, displays the Gift Aid Claimable Address and Address Gone Away Date on the Details tab.

property.name: showPeriodsTab
property.label: Show Periods Tab
property.description: When checked, displays a Periods tab listing the contact's Gift Aid Coverage Periods, so no related list is needed on the page layout.
